What's your return and refund policy?
We offer a 60-day return policy from the date your package arrives. You are welcome to try our products during this period, and if you find they are not the right fit for your skin or you would like to try something else, you can start a return or exchange.
To begin the process, please visit our Returns Center here: https://returns.dimebeautyco.com/. Return shipping charges are deducted from your refund unless you received a defective item or the wrong product. All returns must be packaged appropriately to ensure they arrive safely; if products are damaged during return shipping, we are unable to honor a reimbursement.

If you receive a defective item, we want to ensure you are taken care of. Issues such as defective or damaged products, unusual texture or color, or packaging problems should be reported within 60 days of delivery. To help us resolve the issue quickly, please provide a photo showing the problem, and if the product is leaking or damaged, a photo of the bottom of the bottle with the lot code is very helpful.
If you purchased Redo Package Protection with your order, you can file a claim directly through our Package Protection portal for a replacement. The average response time for claims review is 24–48 business hours. You can access the claims portal here: https://dimebeautyco.com/apps/redo/returns-portal/login
